export_trained_model: export a trained Demucs model from a full checkpoint to a final release checkpoint with only the model
export_model_with_checksum: export a trained Demucs model and add a sha256 prefix checksum to the output filename
export_model_to_custom_path: export a trained Demucs model to a custom output directory instead of the default release_models folder
serialize_model_half_float: serialize a Demucs model as half float to save space with no impact on the final loss
export_quantized_model: export a DiffQ quantized and bitpacked Demucs model from its training checkpoint
